recognize_zh: 薄層血片中央一個細長、兩端較尖的新月形（banana-shaped）寄生蟲，細胞質藍紫色、中央有較集中的染色質與暗色瘧色素，旁邊可見淡色紅血球殘膜；新月形配子體是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）的特徵。
features: Single elongated crescent-shaped (falciform) parasite longer than the diameter of a red cell
Relatively pointed ends with bluish-purple cytoplasm, favoring a female macrogametocyte
Chromatin and dark malarial pigment concentrated toward the center of the parasite
Faint remnant of the host red cell membrane visible along the concave side
Surrounding red cells unremarkable; no ring forms identified in this field; scattered platelets
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a single elongated, crescent-shaped intraerythrocytic parasite that exceeds the diameter of a red cell, with bluish cytoplasm, relatively tapered ends and centrally concentrated chromatin and pigment. A faint remnant of the host red cell membrane is seen adjacent to the concave border. No ring forms are present in this field. Findings are consistent with a gametocyte of Plasmodium falciparum, with features favoring a female (macro)gametocyte; parasitemia should be quantified on additional fields.

ddx.vs: Male microgametocytes are more sausage-shaped with blunt rounded ends, paler cytoplasm and diffuse chromatin with scattered pigment.
Non-falciparum gametocytes are round to oval and fill an enlarged or normal-sized red cell rather than forming a crescent.
Sickle cells are uniformly pink without chromatin, cytoplasm or pigment.
Trypanosomes are extracellular with a nucleus, kinetoplast, undulating membrane and flagellum.
